scope: Isolated native taskbar draft on named Linux Wine desktop, not production or PS5 qualification
oracle: Installed GUI-capable Linux Wine 11.18; fixed Windows 11 reference unavailable
host_adapter: Only the unused GE-Proton EXPLORER_LD_PRELOAD bridge is omitted: host environment has no preload entry and host Wine lacks its private ntdll exports. Taskbar code is identical to the native draft. Host uses named TaskbarHost to avoid the existing Default desktop owner.
results: real shell tray and named desktop
full-width bottom taskbar, 48 pixels at 96 DPI
accessible Start button and live clock/date

prior_attempts.reason: Unmodified PS5-built Explorer stops before UI at unavailable host ntdll preload export
Default already owned by host Explorer; its legacy tray was observed instead of draft
Diagnostic class comparison was case-sensitive; native class is Static, not STATIC

limitations: temporary draft outside frozen production source
classic Start remains; approved Start panel not implemented
no displayed-pixel, hardware-input, frame-pacing or fullscreen qualification
